text_en: It's time that Guardian met Zarga's determination.
This has to be it this time, and he better get us home... or else.
In fact, he's gonna spend a good while not being able to receive any more guests.
I'll personally make sure of it!
You're one of a kind, soldier. Did you think about what I said? About coming over to my regiment?
Hahahah. Alright, you think about it and let me know.
